name: Arepo
summary: A massively parallel code for gravitational N-body and hydrodynamics simulations, including cosmological setups.
scope: DIPL models and native input generation for the 16 bundled examples in the pinned public Arepo source.
validation_qualifier: Locally verified on 2026-10-09: 40 tests and 28 subtests passed against the pinned Arepo source, and mhd_shock_tube built and completed as a smoke run on macOS. Scientific-result validation and other platforms remain separate checks.
limitations: This is an external native-file adapter, not direct SNT3 integration in Arepo. Active settings are compared for bundled examples; comments, ordering, and file bytes are outside that comparison. The local build/run hook completed one mhd_shock_tube smoke run on macOS; other examples, platforms, and physical simulation results are not validated. Upstream endorsement is not established.
